# Dangerous Excel Shortcuts

> Excel shortcuts that silently change more than the cell you're looking at. Reference-only. 34 entries across 9 categories. Part of The Arsenal (https://rblake2320.github.io/).

Note for agents: this page renders its cards with client-side JavaScript, so a plain HTTP fetch of index.html will not contain the entries. Fetch the structured data directly instead:
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rblake2320/dangerous-excel-shortcuts/main/data.json

## Data schema
Array of objects: cat (category), cmd (command or key combo), desc (what it does and why it matters), badge/badgeLabel (risk tier), shell ("cmd"|"ps"|"bash"), optional needsAdmin (bool), optional isInfo (bool = concept/reference card, not runnable).

## Categories
- Data Destruction Risks
- Filtered & Visible-Only
- Flash Fill & AutoFill
- Navigation Power Moves
- Paste Special
- Recalculation & Auditing
- Repeat & Redo
- Selection Traps
- Workbook-Wide Risks
